reviews.title: Life Changing App
reviews.text: This app has given me accountability and resilience throughout the hardest time of my life. I use it daily to check in and keep track of my progress and milestones. I’m doing the hard work but this simple application gives me the time I need to reflect on how far I have come and where I want to go. By checking in and keeping milestones I am able to continue my successful recovery. Very thankful I found this.
App is great, dont know why updates are needed. Last one was significantly worse. Dont fix what aint broke. Old layout was way better.

reviews.title: The best

reviews.title: So glad to have found this!
reviews.text: I love that this app was developed by Parker S. - and shared with us as way to be of service.     Besides the day counter and widget, he’s included a great assortment of other recovery tools.  I like it much better than the apps that seem motivated more by profit than “one addict helping another addict”…  I highly recommend it!

reviews.title: This app changed my life .. really
reviews.text: My drinking was starting to become a problem and uncontrollable habit . I was alone on this journey and had zero support . Whenever I felt like giving up I’d take a look at my achievements and how far I’ve come so far and it kept me pushing . I’d take a look at my 72 hour sober coin and felt a tiny bit of accomplishment and it pushed me toward the next goal. If I could not drink for 24 hours maybe I could make it 48 hours without a drink. Now I’m almost at 6 years no alcohol and I feel great and a huge part of my journey is this app. Thank you from the bottom of my heart and if this app works for you please contribute ..

reviews.title: Love this app!
reviews.text: I have been using this app for almost 10 years. Very handy to keep track of attempts and successes of changing your life.

reviews.title: Made by someone who actually cares
reviews.text:
Wonderful app for tracking sober streaks. Has a community of people you can partner up with or just leave encouragement to. 

Not just for alcohol, but substance abuse, ED’s, anything you want to stop doing and start tracking your clean days. 

There’s an “encourage” tab where people post statuses of where they’re at and so many people come show love. It’s beautiful. And there’s no BS charges, it’s all free. 

The guy who made this genuinely wants to help you, not take your money like other apps.

reviews.text:
I’ve tried most and this is the best app to track recovery days, sobriety days or just days since your last anything. Thanks for making this app!

** The new app update in Sept of 2026 is fantastic! Great features. Def helping me stay sober

reviews.title: Terrific app
reviews.text: If you’ve got a vice or addiction you’re looking to free yourself from, download this app. Being able to track and take pride in how long you’ve been free is an under-appreciated aspect of recovery. This is app was built by someone who genuinely cares and seemingly wants to help others. I used to pay $17.99 for an app that froze 95% of the time and wouldn’t allow me to access the features that this app provides for free. Additionally, I bought the widget app that goes along with NoMo for a one-time payment of $1.99 which has also been a huge help.

reviews.title: Six years in counting!
reviews.text: I love that nomo has been on my side these past six years as a journey through sobriety. The app has more features to offer than it did six years ago, it’s growing too😉. So if you need an app that is not obtrusive or sharing data (at least I hope they still don’t), this one’s for you. And be sure make a donation Parker afloat! The other apps charge monthly or annual fee fees for Parker has managed to create a supporting an offer to us for free.
